Entity.name: Non-perpetual debt security
Entity.commentInRDBMS:
A Term debt security is a Debt security that has a fixed maturity date and is not redeemable before that date.
This can be a term debt security that runs until its maturity date and is not redeemable before that date, or it can be a callable debt security that, when certain conditions are met, can be redeemed before its maturity date.

Attribute.name: Legal final maturity date
Attribute.comment: Legal final maturity date is the contractual maturity date of the Non-perpetual debt security, taking into account any agreements amending initial contracts.
